Inference in Protégé

Released Sep 11, 2025, 20 min

Play Inference in Protégé on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

Learn how to use Protégé with the HermiT reasoner to display inferences automatically in your ontology. In this tutorial, we walk through a simple example with Hammers and Tools, showing how class restrictions and property values can lead to inferred knowledge.

You’ll see how:

  • A hammer, defined as a subclass of tools, is inferred to be a tool.
  • An equivalence axiom with an owl:Restriction allows Protégé to infer new property values (e.g., a hammer’s primary function is hammering nails).
  • Protégé displays both asserted facts and inferred facts clearly once the reasoner is enabled.

This is a great starting point if you’re learning description logics, OWL reasoning, or just want to make the most of Protégé’s built-in reasoning capabilities.
